limitations: An Admin-created source review link was denied to Manager: private review is creator-scoped. Manager publishes a separate guide through the supported creation flow.
A live native request returned safe source-only evidence, not a complete generated layout.
aiBudgetRationale: Bounded complete role coverage plus one targeted native retry; each runtime retains its own provider-step deadline. Denied attempts also count.
coverage: Supported Staff flows attempted with real Supabase Test, formal staff sessions and the saved live AI configuration. Failures are recorded; no universal AI PASS claim.

findings.title: Operations Ask AI is inconsistent
findings.evidence: Admin order query, Manager order query and Manager knowledge query returned HTTP 503. Technician order/knowledge and Admin knowledge succeeded. Safe server reasons INVALID_EXCERPT and PROVIDER_FAILURE were observed; exact per-request reason is not available for every failure.
findings.next: Targeted provider/runtime investigation with fixed fixtures; preserve scoped evidence and exact-excerpt checks.

findings.title: Native model sometimes ignores required source reading or returns incomplete output
findings.evidence: First Admin focus returned Sources only; first preparation was rejected with TOOL_CHOICE_IGNORED. One explicit selected-order retry prepared and executed a saved proposal.
findings.next: Improve current provider/tool compatibility and failure recovery without accepting unsupported model content.

findings.title: AI proposal date did not match the requested date
findings.evidence: Requested 8 October 2026 10:00 MYT; the saved proposal used 10 August. Main verified order/technician but missed date before confirmation. Manager later corrected the same order to 2026-10-08T02:00:00Z while preserving technician.
findings.next: Verify every canonical field against the actual request before approval; add a targeted date/locale regression before claiming reliable AI scheduling.

findings.title: Native knowledge requests completed as clarification without cited guidance
findings.evidence: Both recorded native guidance requests returned clarification views; these prove completed safe responses, not successful knowledge retrieval.
findings.next: Investigate literal query selection with an actual citation assertion.

findings.title: Formal order detail still shows technician UUID
findings.evidence: The formal Manager order detail renders a stored technician identifier; the recording captions do not replace this UI.
findings.next: Separate UI change decision; no product UI modified in this recording task.
